title: Modularizing Rails Monoliths One Bite at a Time
summary: Using the packwerk gem and an iterative approach to simplify applications
body_markdown:
As Rails monoliths grow, coupling becomes increasingly difficult to manage. Developers often reach for microservices to help simplify things, but instead find higher complexity. The Modular Monolith approach is a proven, lightweight alternative that offers the benefits of enforced boundaries without being cumbersome. I spoke at the 2023 Rocky Mountain Ruby conference on how teams can use a phased approach to refactoring toward this style using the[packwerk](https://github.com/Shopify/packwerk) gem. At Doximity, we've used this gem and a phased approach to break some of our most critical rails applications into modules that are easier for our teams to work with.


In November, 2023, I also chatted with Elise Shaffer on[The Ruby on Rails Podcast](https://www.therubyonrailspodcast.com/495) about our experience with application modularization at Doximity.
